output.answer:
Tencent has reported two different "Q2" results depending on which year you mean. Here are the key figures:

## Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026 — most recent)

- **Total revenue: RMB 204.79 billion** (~US$28.5B), up **+11% YoY**, beating consensus of ~RMB 202.8B
- Gross profit: +13% YoY
- Non-IFRS operating profit: +9% YoY; operating profit excluding new AI products was RMB 86.1B (+19% YoY)
- Net profit attributable to equity holders: RMB 56.0B (roughly flat); non-IFRS net profit RMB 68.4B (+9%)
- Segments: VAS RMB 98.4B (+8%), domestic games RMB 47.3B (+17%), marketing services RMB 43.6B (+22%), FinTech & Business Services RMB 60.3B (+9%)
- Monthly active users: WeChat/WeChat combined MAU **1,439 million**

## Q2 2025 (for comparison)

- **Total revenue: RMB 184.5 billion** (~US$25.7B), up **+15% YoY**, beating estimates of ~RMB 178.5B
- Domestic games RMB 40.4B (+17%); international games RMB 18.8B (+35%)
- Marketing services RMB 35.8B (+20%)
- Net profit RMB 55.6B, beating expectations of ~RMB 52.3B
- Capex RMB 19.1B

**Sources:**
- Q2 2026 results: [Tencent Q2 2026 results (PRNewswire/Yahoo Finance)](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/tencent-announces-2026-second-quarter-102900627.html) and [HK Yahoo Finance summary](https://hk.finance.yahoo.com/news/%E6%B8%AF%E8%82%A1%E6%A5%AD%E7%B8%BE-%E9%A8%B0%E8%A8%8A%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E5%AD%A3%E7%B8%BE%E5%8B%9D%E9%A0%90%E6%9C%9F-%E7%B6%93%E8%AA%BF%E6%95%B4%E7%B4%94%E5%88%A9%E5%A4%9A%E8%B3%BA9-%E8%87%AA%E7%94%B1%E7%8F%BE%E9%87%91%E6%B5%81%E8%B2%A0138%E5%84%84%E5%85%83%E4%BA%BA%E6%B0%91%E5%B9%A3-093728714.html)
- Q2 2025 results: [Reuters via Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/chinas-tencent-reports-q2-revenue-084229313.html) and [Tencent 2025 Q2 announcement (HK Yahoo)](https://hk.finance.yahoo.com/news/%E9%A8%B0%E8%A8%8A%E5%85%AC%E4%BD%88%E4%BA%8C%E9%9B%B6%E4%BA%8C%E4%BA%94%E5%B9%B4%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E5%AD%A3%E6%A5%AD%E7%B8%BE-094600113.html)
